Organic ceiling

Reach depends on you posting

124k people follow you and your last 7 reels averaged 12.9k views, with 3 reels in the last week. The free training only reaches the people organic reaches, and only while you keep that pace.

A big jump

Free, then straight to an application

Someone who loved the training but isn't ready to apply for coaching or matchmaking has nothing small to say yes to on your site. They drift back to the feed.

Readers you can't see

Book buyers belong to the retailers

10 Dates to Your Soulmate sells through Target, Barnes & Noble, Amazon and Audible, so you only meet the readers who come and find you afterwards.

No filter

The application does all the sorting

With no paid step before it, the only signal of who is serious is who fills in a form, so your team spends time on applicants who were never going to start.

The free training does its job. What's missing is a small first purchase that pays for ads and shows you who is ready for Find The One.

Meet Dr. Christie

Hi, I'm Christie

I'm a licensed marriage and family therapist, a former eHarmony matchmaker and the author of 10 Dates to Your Soulmate. I studied psychology and marriage and family therapy at USC, all the way to my doctorate.

Date with intention, not guesswork.

You may have seen me on ABC, NBC or KTLA, or in The Wall Street Journal, the Los Angeles Times or Cosmopolitan. This kit is the simplest way I know to start: a few minutes a day, with the same frameworks I use with my coaching clients.

Questions

Before you start

Is this therapy?

No. It's a self-guided educational coaching kit of lessons and exercises for dating with intention. It isn't a replacement for therapy.

Do I need to be on the apps?

No. Day 3 covers profiles for anyone who uses them, and every other day works however you meet people.

How much time does it take?

About 15 minutes a day for seven days. Go at your own pace, and keep access.

What if it's not for me?

[Your refund terms.]

If you want to keep going, Ditch the Dating Apps goes deeper, and you can apply for my Find The One programme.

Before our call, take five minutes with these:

1. What does the relationship you want actually look like, day to day?
2. Where have you been meeting people, and what's been getting in the way?
3. What would make the next six months feel different from the last six?

No need to send me the answers. Just bring your thoughts, and find somewhere quiet for the call.
